crossRefs.note: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
Your head on you is like Carmel. The hair of your head like purple. The king is held captive in its tresses.
The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he contended with God.
Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and…
As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and…
Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am…
I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write…
But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”
“Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth; break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child: for…
But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

translations.web: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.
translations.bsb: I had just passed them when I found the one I love. I held him and would not let go until I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the chamber of the one who conceived me.
translations.kjv: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived
translations.asv: It was but a little that I passed from them, When I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, Until I had brought him into my mother's house, And into the chamber of her that conceived me.
